How to Check Your Muqeem Visa Validity Tracking the validity of your Muqeem visa is vital for adhering to Saudi Arabia’s immigration rules. It prevents overstaying and ensures that your records remain spotless—something especially important when seeking employment or engaging in official activities. Here’s how to check your Muqeem visa validity: You can verify your Iqama expiration through three main platforms: the Ministry of Labor (MoL) website, the Absher portal, and the Absher mobile app. Each of these platforms provides easy access to your Iqama details. Follow the steps below to check your visa status using these services: Visit the MoL website, Absher portal, or open the Absher mobile app. Log in using your credentials or create an account if you haven’t already. Navigate to the Iqama services or expiry section. Enter your Iqama number or national ID. View your visa’s expiration date and other related details. MoL KSA Website The Ministry of Labor (MoL) website is an accessible option for checking your Iqama’s expiration date, especially if you are not registered on Absher. Here’s how to use it: Go to the official MoL website . Locate the E-Services section on the homepage. Click on “Iqama Expiry” or “Employee Services.” Enter your Iqama number and the verification code. Submit the details, and your Iqama expiration date will appear on the screen. This method is great for those who prefer not to use Absher. Checking Muqeem Visa Validity via Absher Portal The Absher portal, managed by the Saudi Ministry of Interior, is another reliable option for checking your Iqama’s expiration. It offers a wide range of services, including visa validity checks. Follow these steps to use the Absher portal: Visit the Absher portal at absher.sa . Log in with your Absher ID and password. If you don’t have an Absher account, create one. From the dashboard, select Iqama Services. Click on “Query Iqama Expiry” and input your Iqama number. Your Iqama expiry details will be displayed. Absher is a secure platform widely used for services such as Iqama renewal and checking traffic violations. Using the Absher Mobile App to Check Iqama Expiry For those who prefer checking their visa status on the go, the Absher mobile app is an excellent choice. Available on both iOS and Android, it provides easy access to government services. Here’s how to check your Iqama status using the app: Download the Absher app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. Log in with your Absher account credentials. Navigate to the Iqama Services section. Tap on “Query Iqama Expiry” and enter your Iqama number. Your Iqama expiry date will be shown. The Absher app is user-friendly and offers convenient access to a variety of government services. Printing Your Muqeem Exit/Re-entry Visa To print your Muqeem exit/re-entry visa, follow these steps: Visit the official Muqeem portal at https://muqeem.sa . Log in with your credentials. Go to the “Visa Services” section and select the Exit/Re-entry visa option. Find your visa by entering the visa number or your personal details. Download the visa in PDF format. Open the file and print it directly from your PDF reader. Checking Muqeem Registration Status To verify your Muqeem registration status, follow these steps: Go to the Muqeem website at muqeem.sa . Log in with your Iqama number and password. Navigate to the “Iqama Services” or “Resident Services” section. Select the option to check your registration status. Review the status and check for any issues or pending updates. By checking your registration, you can ensure compliance with Saudi regulations. How Greenlandoep Can Help with Obtaining

1.fact: Checking your Muqeem visa validity is simple and can be done through several platforms.
1.explanation: Muqeem visa validity can be checked easily online via platforms such as the Ministry of Labor (MoL) website, the Absher portal, and the Muqeem portal itself.

2.fact: You can verify your Iqama expiration through three main platforms: the Ministry of Labor (MoL) website, the Absher portal, and the Absher mobile app.
2.explanation: The Absher portal and Absher mobile app are official platforms managed by the Saudi Ministry of Interior for checking Iqama expiry. The Ministry of Labor (MoL) website also provides some services related to Iqama expiry, but the primary and most reliable platforms are Absher and Muqeem portals. The Muqeem portal is specifically used for exit/re-entry visa status. The MoL website is less commonly used for Iqama expiry checks compared to Absher.

3.fact: To check your visa status using these services: Visit the MoL website, Absher portal, or open the Absher mobile app. Log in using your credentials or create an account if you haven’t already. Navigate to the Iqama services or expiry section. Enter your Iqama number or national ID. View your visa’s expiration date and other related details.
3.explanation: These steps accurately describe the process of checking Iqama or Muqeem visa status on the mentioned platforms. Absher requires login credentials, and the MoL website offers an option to check Iqama expiry by entering the Iqama number and verification code.

4.fact: The Ministry of Labor (MoL) website is an accessible option for checking your Iqama’s expiration date, especially if you are not registered on Absher.
4.explanation: While the MoL website provides some e-services related to employees and Iqama expiry, the Absher portal is the primary and more comprehensive platform for checking Iqama expiry. The MoL site can be used but is less commonly referenced for this purpose.

5.fact: The Absher portal, managed by the Saudi Ministry of Interior, is another reliable option for checking your Iqama’s expiration. It offers a wide range of services, including visa validity checks.
5.explanation: Absher is the official platform managed by the Saudi Ministry of Interior and is widely used for checking Iqama expiry, visa status, and other government services.

6.fact: The Absher app is user-friendly and offers convenient access to a variety of government services.
6.explanation: The Absher mobile app is available on iOS and Android and provides easy access to government services including Iqama expiry checks.

7.fact: To print your Muqeem exit/re-entry visa, visit the official Muqeem portal at https://muqeem.sa, log in, go to the Visa Services section, select the Exit/Re-entry visa option, find your visa by entering the visa number or your personal details, download the visa in PDF format, and print it.
7.explanation: The Muqeem portal allows users to check and print their exit/re-entry visa by logging in and accessing the relevant visa services section.

8.fact: To verify your Muqeem registration status, go to the Muqeem website at muqeem.sa, log in with your Iqama number and password, navigate to the Iqama Services or Resident Services section, select the option to check your registration status, and review the status.
8.explanation: The Muqeem portal provides services to check registration status and ensure compliance with Saudi regulations by logging in and accessing the relevant sections.
